title: Cubic bound on the run length
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, and let $n,T\in\mathbb{N}$ and $z$ be a finite binary string. Put $L$ equal to the maximum length of the templates associated with $M$, $K=L+3$, and $S=k(2T+1)+|z|+n+3$. Define $A=k((2T+3)(L+20))+(|z|+n+2)(L+20)+K+9(T+1)S+6$ and $B=3n+2T+|z|(L+3)+2(L+1)+6$. Then $B+(T+1)(A+7T+10)+L+2\le 60(k+1)(L+30)(n+T+|z|+3)^3$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
